event:acquisitions_and_disposals.label: Acquisition of SR Technics Malta maintenance facility
event:acquisitions_and_disposals.note: easyJet completed the acquisition of the SR Technics Malta maintenance facility and welcomed its skilled new colleagues. Quote (page 61): "In May, we finalised the acquisition of the SR Technics Malta maintenance facility and welcomed 400 highly skilled and valued new colleagues."

event:costs.label: Investment in spares to limit aircraft grounding
event:costs.note: easyJet invested significantly in spares because supply-chain delays made just-in-time spares unviable. Quote (page 21): "Significant investment in spares made during the year, continuing a trend started in 2023. Global supply-chain issues with spares means that it is no longer viable to run a just-in-time spares process due to delivery delays, and so we have made this investment to minimise the period of time when aircraft are grounded"

event:fleet_and_engines.label: Fleet renewal with NEO aircraft deliveries
event:fleet_and_engines.note: NEO aircraft joined the fleet during the year, with a large number still on order. Quote (page 41): "16 NEO aircraft joined the fleet, with a further 299 on order."

event:funding_and_rating.label: Eurobond issued under EMTN programme
event:funding_and_rating.note: easyJet issued a euro-denominated guaranteed bond under its EMTN programme, maturing in 2031. Quote (page 148): "March 2024: Eurobonds consisting of €850 million guaranteed Notes paying 3.750% coupon and maturing in 2031."

event:funding_and_rating-2.label: Credit rating upgrade noted by committee
event:funding_and_rating-2.note: The audit committee reviewed easyJet's credit rating position and noted an upgrade of rating. Quote (page 119): "The Committee reviewed easyJet’s credit rating position and noted the upgrade of rating from"
